title: MoEless: Efficient MoE LLM Serving with Serverless Experts
abstract: arXiv:2603.06350v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly adopt Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures to scale efficiently under stringent resource constraints. However, MoE's sparse activation causes severe expert load imbalance, where a few experts become stragglers while others remain underutilized, leading to inflated inference latency and cost. Existing solutions assume static, serverful model deployments, limiting expert elasticity and often incurring costly expert swapping or degraded output quality. We present MoEless, an efficient serverless MoE serving framework that mitigates expert load imbalance via elastic expert execution. MoEless leverages lightweight, layer-aware predictors to estimate incoming expert load distributions and proactively identify stragglers. translated_title: MoEless：基于无服务器专家的高效MoE大语言模型服务系统
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地采用专家混合（MoE）架构，以便在严格的资源约束下实现高效扩展。然而，MoE的稀疏激活会导致严重的专家负载不均衡问题：少数专家成为拖慢整体进度的“掉队者”，而其他专家则处于利用不足的状态，从而导致推理延迟和成本的显著增加。现有解决方案假设采用静态的、基于服务器的模型部署方式，限制了专家的弹性伸缩，并且往往需要付出高昂的专家交换开销，或导致输出质量下降。我们提出了MoEless，一个高效的无服务器MoE服务框架，通过弹性专家执行来缓解专家负载不均衡问题。MoEless利用轻量级的、面向层的预测器来估计即将到来的专家负载分布，并主动识别掉队专家。我们设计了优化的扩缩容和放置策略，以提升函数局部性、GPU利用率以及跨专家的负载均衡。MoEless在Megatron-（基础上构建了原型系统）。
tldr: MoEless提出了一个无服务器MoE服务框架，通过轻量级负载预测和弹性专家执行策略缓解专家负载不均衡问题，从而提升GPU利用率并降低推理延迟与成本。
en_tdlr: MoEless presents a serverless MoE serving framework that mitigates expert load imbalance through lightweight layer-aware load prediction and elastic expert execution, improving GPU utilization and reducing inference latency and cost.
